cohort: Term-pregnant women, categorized as non-obese controls or Class II obese (BMI 35-40), all undergoing Caesarian section.
finding: Acute in vivo innate immune responses to C-section, as well as subsequent in vitro stimulation, were indistinguishable between Class II obese and non-obese term-pregnant women, despite obese women having higher baseline inflammatory status.
mod_finding: The acute in vivo innate immune response to Caesarian section was not detectably altered in Class II obese women compared to non-obese controls.
